$comment: Committed copy of the labelled accuracy set. Same cases and labels as dataset.json, but the text of prompts that contain a synthetic key, token, password or certificate is left out (text: null), because such values look real to secret scanners. Run `node eval/accuracy/build-dataset.mjs` to produce the full dataset.json; its SHA-256 must equal fullDatasetSha256.
